title: Clerk agent command
description: A copyable one-line prompt for coding agents. Tab style: a dark folder tab with an S-curved edge (a stack of small round marks and a label) sitting on a pale, softly shadowed mono command bar with a copy button. Pill style: a compact grey pill with the marks, the label and a copy icon.
notes: copies to the clipboard and swaps the icon for a tick, so it needs JavaScript
name: clerk-command

props.name: label
props.description: label on the tab or pill (e.g. "Build with agents")

props.name: command
props.description: the text that gets copied; shown in the bar in the tab style

props.name: marks
props.description: small round marks stacked before the label (agent or tool logos)

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: screen-reader label of the copy button

props.name: variant
props.description: tab: dark folder tab over a command bar · pill: compact grey pill
